sentences.en: His ambition was to break into television as an announcer.
sentences.zh: 他的雄心是成为一名电视主播。

sentences.en: He never forgot his ambition to become a great statesman.
sentences.zh: 他从未忘记成为伟大政治家的抱负。

sentences.en: Her ambition was consummated when she was elected to Congress.
sentences.zh: 当选为国会议员实现了她的野心。
